patterns.name: Top Rejected External Ingress by Port
patterns.description: Ranks target destination ports rejecting external inbound connections.
patterns.cql: #repo = "aws-vpc-flow-logs" #action = "REJECT" | test(!cidr(field=srcaddr, subnet="10.0.0.0/8")) | test(!cidr(field=srcaddr, subnet="172.16.0.0/12")) | test(!cidr(field=srcaddr, subnet="192.168.0.0/16")) | groupBy([dstport], function=count(as=reject_count)) | sort(field=reject_count, order=desc) | head(20)

patterns.name: Horizontal Port Scan Detection
patterns.description: Detects single source IPs attempting connections across more than 20 unique ports within 5 minutes.
patterns.cql: #repo = "aws-vpc-flow-logs" #action = "REJECT" | groupBy([srcaddr], function=([count(dstport, distinct=true, as=unique_ports), count(as=total_attempts)])) | test(unique_ports >= 20) | sort(field=unique_ports, order=desc)

patterns.name: Large Outbound Data Transfer Anomalies
patterns.description: Spots external outbound data transfers exceeding 100 megabytes in a single flow session.
patterns.cql: #repo = "aws-vpc-flow-logs" #action = "ACCEPT" bytes > 104857600 | test(!cidr(field=dstaddr, subnet="10.0.0.0/8")) | mb_transferred := bytes / 1048576 | select([@timestamp, srcaddr, dstaddr, dstport, mb_transferred]) | sort(field=mb_transferred, order=desc)
